china-1916:p0246_1.rationale: Value of a railway's rolling stock, plant, stores, cash and investments in Kuping taels; the railway asset account is the main subject.

china-1916:p0246_2.rationale: Receipts by source in the railway's 1910 profit and loss account.

china-1916:p0247_1.rationale: Railway expenditure items, total and grand profit.

china-1916:p0253_1.rationale: Locomotive inventory of a railway by type, wheel arrangement, weight and maker.

china-1916:p0258_1.rationale: Receipts and expenditure of the Chinese Eastern Railway in roubles, 1908-1912.

china-1916:p0259_1.rationale: Lengths of principal river bridges on a railway, including the Mukden-Antung line. These are railway assets, so roads-and-bridges is not used.

china-1916:p0259_2.rationale: Lengths of the principal tunnels on the Mukden-Antung railway line.

china-1916:p0260_1.rationale: Company capital expenditure by item (railway, steamships, electricity, gas, harbour, hotels, collieries, etc.) in yen. It is a diversified company investment account with no single fitting tag.
review_questions: Should a tag for company capital accounts be added? The existing 'companies' tag is possible but was not applied.

china-1916:p0269_1.rationale: Annual postal results, including offices, articles, parcels and money orders, over six years.

china-1916:p0270_1.rationale: Length in li and miles of courier, steamer and boat, and railway lines of communication. It is a mixed network-length summary with no specific tag.
review_questions: Is a tag for transport and communication network length needed?
